## Overview

MarkdStage v3.0.0 makes deck navigation easier to scan, clarifies the boundary between Markdown
files and Canvas API input, and ensures Mermaid diagrams are present in exported PDFs.

Title and section slides now stand out in the slide list, while slides within a section are
indented beneath it. PDF generation now waits for asynchronous rendering to finish before printing.
The CLI uses distinct action-oriented commands for previewing and presenting a deck.

## Compatibility and migration

Existing MarkdStage Markdown decks, Canvas Extension installations, and Architecture DSL v1
documents remain compatible. The CLI command names are intentionally not backward compatible:
`presentation` is removed, and the previous `present` preview behavior moves to `preview`.

| Area | Migration |
| --- | --- |
| Version-pinned installation | Update the pinned tag to `v3.0.0`. |
| CLI authoring and preview | Replace `markdstage present <file> [--watch]` with `markdstage preview <file> [--watch]`. |
| CLI presenter view | Replace `markdstage presentation <file>` with `markdstage present <file>`. |
| Offline CLI installation | Download and install `markdstage-markdstage-3.0.0.tgz` from the GitHub Release. |
